title: Celestial Mother and Twins
description: A woman with long flowing auburn hair sits in a cosmic landscape holding two infants. She is surrounded by glowing zodiac constellations, a crescent moon dripping golden liquid, and a starry night sky with nebulae.
prompt: A beautiful woman with long wavy auburn hair wearing a dark blue and patterned robe sits in a mystical cosmic landscape at night, cradling two newborn twin babies in her arms, one baby reaching up toward a glowing geometric shape, surrounded by translucent ribbons of glowing zodiac symbols floating in the air, a large crescent moon with golden droplets hanging in the starry sky above, dramatic nebulae and clouds in the background, highly detailed fantasy illustration
